items.reason: Captured gameplay frames use a consistent shape language and palette across combat and exploration.
limitations: Only the current Beta build was inspected.
items.nextIteration: Compare new environments against the locked visual direction.

items.reason: Character, environment, and effect assets are production-ready for the stated visual direction.
limitations: Unused and late-game assets were not inspected.
items.nextIteration: Audit the remaining late-game asset set.

items.reason: The HUD hierarchy, contrast, and layout remain readable in the captured gameplay states.
limitations: Small-screen and accessibility variants were not captured.
items.nextIteration: Capture the smallest supported viewport and high-density inventory states.

items.reason: Hits, rewards, and danger states have distinct visual feedback that supports the intended emotion.
limitations: The judgment is based on recorded output rather than a target-player session.
items.nextIteration: Observe whether target players notice each critical feedback state.

items.reason: The implemented explore, fight, reward, and upgrade loop presents a credible attraction based on the available gameplay evidence.
limitations: No target-player experience record is available, so this is an evidence-bounded appeal judgment.
items.nextIteration: Run target-player sessions and record voluntary loop repetition.

items.reason: Available builds and encounter decisions produce materially different outcomes in the implemented Slice.
limitations: Only the implemented Beta choice set was compared.
items.nextIteration: Measure choice distribution and outcome differences in playtests.

items.reason: Goals, encounter pacing, and reward feedback form a legible progression through the evaluated Slice.
limitations: Long-session pacing is outside the available evidence.
items.nextIteration: Test pacing across a complete chapter-length session.

items.reason: Visible upgrades and unresolved goals provide concrete reasons to continue based on the implemented progression evidence.
limitations: No player retention or voluntary continuation record is available.
items.nextIteration: Record whether players voluntarily continue after the first reward cycle.
